tips.text: Check your Plastid stock first; dojo research and crafting drain it, and most players are surprised how low it is.
Do one Salvage run and one Plastid run in the same session.
Build this one even if you own Spira Prime; owning the Prime does not remove the need.
Expect Plastids to be the only real bottleneck; a veteran needs one or two sessions on a loot frame.
